text:
Jules M.: following the postmortem, we found a repeating midnight DB-peak that keeps resurfacing. need a compact playbook: triage commands, who to page, and immediate mitigations. can we assign owners?

Priya K.: i can take the triage cookbook. i'll add a short checklist (what to check first, what to escalate) and copy/paste-safe command snippets. target: draft PR in 7 business days.

Tom L.: i'll pick up the automation piece: a lightweight health-check that exposes connection pool metrics and a one-liner `curl` check for oncall. plan to add to infra-monitoring and a runbook section mapping checks->actions.

Rina G.: i'll do escalation mapping. proposal: embed clear thresholds and next steps. example: conn_util > 75% for 10m -> L2, >90% for 3m -> L1. i'll also include phone roster fallback for weekends.

Priya K.: initial triage steps i'll add:
```
# quick pg active count
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# check recent connection errors in app pods
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | grep -i "connection"
# confirm worker backlog
kubectl -n prod get jobs -l job=nightly | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, status:.status}'
```

ops-bot: New actions created: ACTION-9021 (triage cookbook), ACTION-9022 (health-check), ACTION-9023 (escalation map). Links: https://tracker.redwood/ACTION-9021

Jules M.: please add estimated due dates in the tracker now. we need owners and dates by EOD so PM can close loop.

Tom L.: set mine to 2024-06-12 for the health-check + CI job. will add a tiny smoke test.

Priya K.: triage cookbook due 2024-06-07. will include rollback steps and a short validation script.

Rina G.: escalation map due 2024-06-09. will include escalation steps, example messages, and paging thresholds.

Jules M.: can someone also capture the recurring cause (nightly bulk jobs) as an action to change scheduling? that should be a separate owner.

Priya K.: note: the postmortem recommended staggering job windows — i can draft a short proposal but prefer devs owning job changes. i'll create a checklist for dev leads.

Tom L.: i can add a safety circuit in the job runner to stop submissions if conn_util > 85%. that will be a separate action (ACTION-9024). setting due 2024-06-21.

Rina G.: once PRs land let's do a 20m runbook walkthrough with oncall. i'll schedule for next week.

Jules M.: perfect. weekly 15m sync until all actions are green. tag ACTION-9021/9022/9023/9024 in PRs and link the postmortem. thanks. :thumbsup:
